# Component: ui

Files: `src/ui.ts` (1067 lines), `src/main.ts` (175), `src/style.css` (445), `index.html` (19). Criticality: **Supporting** (the shell around the Core engine).

## 1. Component Overview
`src/main.ts` boots the game: it takes a Web Lock, loads the save, settles away time, builds the UI and runs a 1-second ticker with autosave. `src/ui.ts` is a plain-DOM view built once and then updated in place by `render()`. It decides nothing about game rules: tooltips, availability reasons and costs all come from the engine. [HIGH] (`src/main.ts:160-161`, `src/ui.ts:122`, `src/ui.ts:862`)

- Complexity: **Complex** (one closure of about 940 lines holding every widget).

## 3. Workflows & Behaviors
**WF-ui:001 — System startup / boot sequence** (the system entry point).
1. `navigator.locks.request('lowbridge-active-journey', { ifAvailable })`; no lock → message and stop → `src/main.ts:160-168`
2. `SaveStore.open()`; on failure, autosave is unavailable but the game is still playable → `src/main.ts:36-37`
3. `store.load(records)`; both slots unreadable → blocking import / new-journey screen → `src/main.ts:38-71`
4. `new GameEngine(records, loadedState)`, then `engine.advance(awaySeconds)` using the wall clock since `savedAt` → `src/main.ts:74-80`
5. `settle()` + `createUI(...)` with callbacks; the return summary if away 60 s or more; first `persist()` → `src/main.ts:118-138`
6. `setInterval` ticker (monotonic `performance.now()`) → `src/main.ts:140` [HIGH]

**WF-ui:002 — Player action** → `src/ui.ts:184-187`: `beforeChange` (settle wall time), then the engine call, `render()`, `onChange` (persist). Errors surface in the settings panel. [HIGH]

## 10. Legacy Warnings
- God closure: `createUI` holds every widget and every handler (about 900 lines). [HIGH]
- Hardcoded record ids (`vigor`, `qi`, `life`, `strain`, `rest`, `coin`, `foundation`, `waystation`, `shu_apprentice`, `jade_slip`, `settling`, `home_space`, `attune_slots`). `engine.stat("home_space")` throws if the record is absent (`src/ui.ts:907`). See `.ai/docs/issues.md`. [HIGH]
- The literal `60` duplicates `EXP_PER_LEVEL` (`src/ui.ts:401`, `src/ui.ts:945`). [HIGH]
- The UI has no unit tests; it is covered only by `scripts/browser-smoke.ts`. [HIGH]

## 11. Design Rationale
| Pattern | Location | Rationale | Evidence | Certainty |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Build once, update in place | `src/ui.ts:121` | Ticking must never recreate focused inputs | doc comment | HIGH |
| Monotonic clock while open, wall clock across visits | `src/main.ts:87-92`, `src/main.ts:75-76` | Clock corrections neither freeze progress nor count time twice | `README.md:47` | HIGH |
| Ticker fault stops ticking | `src/main.ts:146-151` | Do not freeze silently; keep the last good save | code comment | HIGH |
